newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Southside School District No.3, Ark., $1.120 million refunding bonds.
--Deep River, Conn., $4.8 million general obligation bonds.
--Panorama Community School District, Iowa, $5.495 million school GOs.
--Averill Park CSD, N.Y., $12.5 million school district bonds.
--Henrico County Ind. Development, Va., $28.765 million lease revenue bonds.
--Ocean City, N.J., Board of Education $2.420 million.
